results.text: From very high: a vast shape of heat, older than any god, curled on a seabed like a sleeping animal. A bird circles above it, patient. The titan opens one eye and looks at you.

results.text: A titan made of the weight of deep water crawls across a dark plain. Something small and bird-shaped rides its back, pecking. Where it pecks, the titan goes quiet. It turns its head toward you.
results.description: A titan made of the weight of deep water crawls across a dark plain. Something small and bird-shaped rides its back, pecking. Where it pecks, the titan goes quiet. It turns its head toward you.

results.text: Time itself as a creature, long and many-jointed, threading between stars. Something follows it with no shape at all, only borrowed voices. The titan stops and looks at you.

results.text: A titan of weight, everything around it falling toward it, half buried and gnawed down to a stump. Wisps feed at the wound. A bird sits on what is left, cleaning its beak. Only the titan sees you.
